results.title: Boost.space is rated "Excellent" with 4.8 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content: When I first signed-up for Boost.space about 9 months ago, the UX was a little bit overwhelming and without a guided experience. You had to figure it all out on your own, and it really wasn't very intuitive. Recently, though, they have implemented a new UX and have made it easier to figure out how to set-up the automations. Visually it's much better, but there is still a learning curve to take into consideration when first using. [...] Boost.space is a game-changer for anyone looking to truly centralize and leverage their data. What I like best is its unparalleled ability to extract specific data from various external sources (like ClickUp and Google Sheets in my case) and consolidate it into dynamic, self-updating dashboards. This has been incredibly powerful for creating personalized, real-time insights that were previously impossible to achieve without manual, time-consuming effort. The promise of an "AI-Ready data sync platform" is absolutely delivered, especially with the built-in AI features that can clean, tag, and enrich your data. It truly unifies your entire ecosystem into one hub, enabling faster automation and smarter decisions. The integration with over 2,200 tools is also a massive advantage for future [...] easy to navigate. Even when I had questions, support was responsive and helpful. The integrations work, and I can focus more on strategy instead of wrangling data. Boost.space has a built-in AI engine that maps and matches input with AI-optimized output. This feature allows it to standardize and enrich data. I use its AI data mapping every time.

results.title: Boost.space 5.0 — The Database Your Automations and AI Agents Have Been Waiting For | Boost.space
results.content:
Simplified settings — advanced features are tucked behind toggles, off by default. Clean interface for new users, full power for those who need it.

Social login — sign in with Google, LinkedIn, or X.

Color-coded selects — assign colors to your Single Select and Multi Select options for instant visual categorization.

New visual identity — refreshed backgrounds, updated branding, and a modernized look across the entire platform.

## Breaking Change: Manual Edit Priority

Manual data editing priority has been changed from High to Medium. This means manual edits and scenario-based updates now share the same default priority level. If you previously relied on manual edits always overriding scenario data, review your priority settings to make sure your data flow behaves the way you expect. [...] This is the big one.

Connect your Make.com account to Boost.space with an API token, and you get a central database behind all your automations — one place where your data lives, gets enriched, and stays consistent across tools. You still build your scenarios in Make.com the way you always have — but now they read from and write to a shared data layer instead of passing data into the void.

No more Google Sheets as a "database." No more duplicated records across tools. No more scenarios that break because one app updated a field format.

### Here's what you get: [...] ## Stop Mapping Fields. Let AI Do It

Every Make.com user knows the pain: you connect a new tool, and then you spend the next hour dragging fields into the right slots. Field by field. Column by column. For every single module.

The new AI Mapping Module ends that.

Drop the entire data bundle from any app in your scenario — HubSpot, Shopify, Stripe, whatever — into Boost.space, and AI figures out the rest. It reads the incoming data, recognizes what each field is, and maps everything to the right columns automatically. If a column doesn't exist yet, it creates one.

One action. Zero manual mapping. Works with any tool.
